description: PL.core-dock-operations-register. GET /api/v1/worlds/{worldId}/neighbourhood?address=<KINP>: what a world knows about one entity, core's narrative-neighbourhood projection (the Neighbourhood panel, Godot). The row publishes its required address parameter. An address the world cannot resolve is the server's 422 NeighbourhoodRefusal, by name; the dock does not classify it. requestCases: what a dock asks for (input: worldId, query parameters by name, a parsed JSON body) -> the request it must send (method, the expanded path, query, body: the JSON value to send or null for none), or the refusal (code, received) with no request at all. An absent body, null and {} all mean no body. row: the published openapi/operations.json row this file is about (method, path, pathParameters, queryParameters, auth, verdict) plus what a request may carry (body, bodyMembers) and whether contentWriteFindings admits it, with the reason; a test holds row to the stamped table and to the vendored contract. cases: no response cases yet (the docks' readers of these answers are the engines' own; none is in core). Reference: src/editor/dock-operations.ts dockOperationRequest, run by src/editor/__tests__/dock-operations.test.ts.

contentWrite.why: A read: a GET, not named as a write and on no entity collection, so contentWriteFindings finds nothing, and it writes nothing.

requestCases.name: address-named
requestCases.why: The panel names the selected entity by its KINP address, minted by core's neighbourhoodAddress(worldId, entityId).

source.note: the neighbourhood read: x-status native, auth optional, the required address query parameter (the entity's KINP identifier; the contract's example is insimul:world:w-millbrook:ent:bld-00), and 'there is no request parameter that moves a policy knob'
